source.prompt: Progressive house song, about 3.5 minutes, 123 BPM, G minor. Hypnotic, warm late-night drive mood that slowly lifts into wide-open hope. Smooth, warm baritone male lead vocal, intimate in the verses, rising and confident on the chorus with soft stacked harmonies. Warm Steinway piano chords, lush string section pads and swells, soft legato flute melody, gentle clean electric guitar with long delay, rolling offbeat finger bass. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, soft 16th hats, light tambourine and ride on the drops. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and piano, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide, smooth mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Verse]
Headlights fading on the coastal road
Engine humming like it always knows
Every mile I leave the noise behind
Chasing something I was meant to find

[Pre-Chorus]
And the night keeps pulling me in
Like a tide beneath my skin

[Chorus]
Hold the horizon, don't let it go
Keep the light where the waters glow
Hold the horizon, steady and slow
I'll be there when the morning shows

[Verse 2]
Radio whispers in a midnight blue
Every song reminds me how I'm closer to you
Salt is rising on the open air
I can feel you waiting out there

[Pre-Chorus]
And the night keeps pulling me in
Like a tide beneath my skin

[Chorus]
Hold the horizon, don't let it go
Keep the light where the waters glow
Hold the horizon, steady and slow
I'll be there when the morning shows

[Bridge]
When the stars start falling down
I won't turn around
I won't turn around
Just keep the line where the sky meets the sea

[Final Chorus]
Hold the horizon, don't let it go
Keep the light where the waters glow
Hold the horizon, steady and slow
I'll be there when the morning shows
I'll be there when the morning shows
